name: ALP
fix_description: Change _swap visibility from public to internal. As a public function, anyone can call it with arbitrary aggregatorData to drain the contract tokens via the 1inch aggregator.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC uses a multi-step attack chain with nested flash loans, Pancake swap/flash callback flow, Venus market entry/collateralization, borrowing across several Dualpools markets, and final unwind/repayment. While the core bug is protocol-specific rather than deeply cryptographic, reproducing the exploit requires understanding lending market mechanics and coordinating several contracts, which is more than a quick obvious-pattern exploit.
